caseStudies.title: Before you write an AI policy, ask the people already using it.
caseStudies.summary: The workforce was already using AI on personal and business accounts. Rather than a policy written in the dark, we ran an anonymous workforce survey — and handed the build to an AI agent that designed and configured it through a browser in about fifteen minutes.

caseStudies.title: Before you overlay AI, build the single source of truth.
caseStudies.summary: A group of 1,400–1,800 sites taking till and app sales, running on disconnected systems and load-bearing spreadsheets — joined up into one governed warehouse (finance, CRM, sales and more), so AI finally had trustworthy data to stand on. With the part nobody publishes: what it costs at every size of business.

caseStudies.title: Bolster the team — hire a semi-autonomous agent.
caseStudies.summary: "Charles" — my first virtual hire — runs a Jira backlog, drafts meeting notes and books meetings. When the email and Teams connectors turned out read-only, a Power Automate, OneNote and SharePoint bridge did the sending. No engineers required.
